preconditions.description: The number of town attractions N is a natural number between 3 and 20 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly N * N numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 1000 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All numbers in the output are between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i * N + i]) == 0 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: All diagonal numbers in the adjacency matrix are zero.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i * N + j]) == int(stdout.split()[j * N + i]) for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
len(set(int(x) for x in stdout.split() if x != '0')) == N * (N - 1) // 2
postconditions.description: All non-zero numbers in the adjacency matrix are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) > 0 for x in stdout.split() if x != '0')
postconditions.description: All non-zero numbers in the adjacency matrix are positive.
